messages:
maria_cs: MapleHealth (renewal in ~3w) just pinged with a SOC2 questionnaire. They want embeddings retention details, KMS rotation evidence for the last 12 months, and a redacted dataflow diagram auditors can use. Putting initial ask here so we can assign owners. Need evidence bundle by next Tue.
maplesec: hi — can you confirm how long embeddings are kept for analytics vs delete-on-request? also need KMS rotation logs (last 12 months). auditors asked for a network/dataflow diagram that hides tenant ids.
ajay_se: short answer — default embeddings retention is 90d for analytics; we can export per-tenant history on request. KMS rotations are tracked in Cloud KMS + CloudTrail. infra needs to pull key-change events + rotation metadata.
leo_infra: I can pull KMS logs and collate rotation events. I need a ticket with the s3 path to drop artifacts. ETA ~48h after ticket creation. Also to produce a redacted diagram I need a sanitized source from devex/ux.
devsec-bot: evidence-bundle generated: s3://redwood-evidence/maplehealth/initial_manifest.json (auto). Will update when artifacts land.
diane_legal: we can share rotation metadata and attestations but NOT raw key material. For the redacted diagram, please use the 'audit-redact' template and remove tenant ids and IPs. I'll drop the template here.
maria_cs: can you drop the template here, @diane_legal? I'll push to the customer once infra uploads logs. @leo_infra can you create the ticket and reply with the id so I can track?
diane_legal: dropping checklist snippet:
```
Audit redaction checklist:
- remove tenant identifiers
- mask internal IPs (10.x/172.x)
- replace hostnames with roles (e.g., inference-gpu-01 -> inference-gpu)
```
leo_infra: ticket created: INF-8721. I'll upload KMS rotation CSV and a filtered CloudTrail view (2024-01-01..2025-12-31). Will drop to s3 and ping here when done. ETA EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup: 
ajay_se: I'll draft a short explainer for retention + per-tenant export steps. quick Q — do we want to include an excerpt about prefix-caching/kv-cache behavior? auditors sometimes ask about cached KV window.
maria_cs: yes include a brief caching note (1–2 lines). Maplesec — can you confirm whether auditors want a live walkthrough or artifacts only? that will determine how much narrative we prepare.
maplesec: artifacts first please. if auditors ask for a call we can schedule after reviewing. thanks.
leo_infra: uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/maplehealth/kms-rotations-2024-2025.csv and s3://redwood-evidence/maplehealth/cloudtrail-kms-filtered.log
devsec-bot: new artifacts detected and attached to bundle. link: https://console.redwood/evidence/maplehealth (internal)
maria_cs: plan: ajay will finish retention explainer + cache note by tomorrow noon; diane will drop the redaction template into the s3 folder; leo will upload final logs by EOD tomorrow. I'll send a short handoff to Maplesec with artifact links and proposed next steps on Mon. :pray:
